Partial fix progress (2 of 3 ticket recommendations):
1. (ticket rec 1) Bypass-enumeration density in HARD-GATEs — SHIPPED by commit d62ce71243 (2026-05-24 white-elephant refactor across brainstorm/sprint/preplanning/implementation-plan).
2. (ticket rec 2) Memory consolidation of stale save-points — SHIPPED this session: removed 3 stale save-point files whose targets are completed (jira_remediation epic 3a03 archived, sprint_81d7 archived + PR #288 merged, recovery_3a03 PR #290 merged); MEMORY.md restructured to separate active save-points from postmortems; 4 stale entries pruned, 1 active save-point retained.
3. (ticket rec 3) Model-tier-vs-content attribution study — NOT addressed; remains an open empirical question (would require sampling agent behavior on skill+memory variants under different model tiers).

Self-observation: I exhibited the exact pattern in this session's brainstorm turn (surfaced '30 batches + 6 reviewers heavyweight' framing, dispatched 6 of 30, offered 'halt all' as user option) — empirical confirmation that recommendation 1's skill-side fix alone is insufficient and recommendation 2's memory consolidation alone may also be insufficient. Recommendation 3's empirical study remains the open question.
